issues.text: REQ-061 criterion 1 contradicts REQ-069 (decisions/0085): after REQ-069 the schema /3 is valid. The fix is a WF-01 amendment of the criterion text, not code (finding RV-B-061-1). The same pattern may exist elsewhere: when a later requirement replaces a test of an earlier done requirement by design, the earlier criterion text is not amended in the same run. Proposal to raise the bar (for ORCH, §4): the replacement table «было → стало» of a design names, for every replaced test, the criterion of the earlier requirement it carries, and WF-01 of the same run amends that criterion; checkable by a grep of the criterion for the old literal.
